$schema: Workday tenants + SmartRecruiters companies + iCIMS hosts for the Workday/SmartRecruiters/iCIMS sources to scan. These ATSes have no cross-company search, so each employer is listed explicitly -- this is how Jobe reaches employers (in any industry) that don't use Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby. EMPTY by default: Jobe ships no curated employer list. Add your target employers, or let `/jobe onboard` collect them. Shapes: workday { host, tenant, site, company, industry }; smartrecruiters { companyId, company, industry }; icims { host, company, industry }.
